privates.name: k.u.k. Post
privates.description: Always assigned to the Luka. The Luka starts with $200 in its treasury. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Narodna Bond
privates.description: One per player, dealt at setup; not auctioned. Can't be sold. From the 4H phase, exchange in a stock round for a reserved 10% Narodna Line share; forced exchange on the first 4+. Reserved shares pay the Narodna Line's treasury.

privates.name: Ganz Locomotive Works
privates.description: Attach when a Luka company you preside floats: it floats at 50% and buys the current train at the mooring discount. Or sell it to any company for $1–200: that company may close it to buy one train from the supply at the discount at any point in its turn, like Wiener Neustadt. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Kupa River Bridge
privates.description: Blocks one Kupa hex (owner's choice). May be exchanged for a reserved Shortline share in a stock round. Forced exchange on the first 4+.

privates.name: Pazin Tunnel Company
privates.description: May be exchanged for a reserved Shortline share in a stock round. Forced exchange on the first 4+.

privates.name: Zadar Station Rights
privates.description: Blocks Zadar. The owning company may lay or upgrade Zadar and place its cheapest station there free, without a connection. At 4–5 players one of P3/P4 is removed at random. Closes on the first 4+. From 4H, may be sold to a company for ½×–1× face.

privates.name: Vukovar Station Rights
privates.description: Blocks Vukovar. The owning company may lay or upgrade Vukovar and place its cheapest station there free, without a connection. At 4–5 players one of P3/P4 is removed at random. Closes on the first 4+. From 4H, may be sold to a company for ½×–1× face.

privates.name: Rijeka Lazaretto
privates.description: Quarantine: once, when a rust would remove a train of a company you preside, that train runs once more, then is removed. It can't be traded in or sold. May be used on the first 4+'s rust. Closes when used or on the first 4+.

privates.name: Dubrovnik Lazaretto
privates.description: 3 players only. Quarantine: once, when a rust would remove a train of a company you preside, that train runs once more, then is removed. It can't be traded in or sold. May be used on the first 4+'s rust. Closes when used or on the first 4+.

privates.name: Kvarner Shipbuilding
privates.description: May be exchanged for a reserved Shortline share in a stock round. Forced exchange on the first 4+.

privates.name: Lika Survey Office
privates.description: Holds the only straight yellow tile. Any company the owner presides may lay it as a normal tile lay. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Slavonian Agricultural Society
privates.description: Comes with a 10% Mainline share. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Wiener Neustadt Locomotive Works
privates.description: From 4H, may be sold to a non-Luka company for $1–200. The owning company may close this to buy a train from the supply at any point in its turn. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Sava Steam Ferry
privates.description: Comes with a 10% Mainline share. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Štedionica
privates.description: Comes with one Mainline share and one random Luka-company share. Never closes or sells. Once per SR the owner buys one certificate or starts a company for it, paying what it can't.

privates.name: Narodna Line Concession
privates.description: Comes with the 20% president's certificate of the Narodna Line (third Luka company drawn), which starts at 86 like the Shortline. Every player starts with a Narodna Bond. The Narodna Line floats when 60% is out of the bank, reserved Bond shares included, and then takes $860 (10 × 86) from the bank. Closes when the Narodna Line operates.

privates.name: Ungaro-Croata Charter
privates.description: Converts as a free action into the Maritime Fund or Ganz. Mooring marker moves each SR; must convert by the SR after the first 4+. 4–5 players only.

privates.name: MÁV Concession
privates.description: Comes with the 20% president's certificate of the Mainline (first Luka company drawn). Closes when the Mainline operates.

privates.name: Südbahn Concession
privates.description: Comes with the 20% president's certificate of the Shortline (second Luka company drawn). Closes when the Shortline operates.

privates.name: Ancona Steamship Line
privates.description: Can't be sold. Once, assign it to a company you preside: free station on Ancona, its routes through Ancona add the largest other city, and its Berth costs $40. Closes when assigned.

trains.description: Runs once more after the Diesel

turns.name: Stock Round
steps: Sell (at most 30% of one company per turn)
One action: buy, start a Luka company (or a Branch in the Late space), split, or act for the Štedionica or Fund

phases.notes: Start prices 80–58; the Late space may start one space higher (86)

notes: Companies may buy Zadar and Vukovar Station Rights (½×–1× face) until the first 4+
Wiener Neustadt can be sold to companies
Ungaro-Croata must convert to the Fund by the end of the next SR
Game end: finish the set, one final SR, then 3 ORs
Each 4+ still runs once after the Diesel and can't be sold
Final 3 ORs: the only tiles that may be laid are the CX (Karlovac) and the one other gray tile
